text:
dan: FYI escalating to engineering — ACME on-prem install can't finish debug bundle upload to our presign endpoint. Collector reports 403 from SFTP presign proxy and the manifest checksum doesn't match. ticket T-9421

maria: Can you drop collector version + the collector config (remove secrets) and one failing request_id? Also paste the presign host (mask token).

dan: Collector v2.3.1. Config: --bundle-path=/var/tmp/debug-bundle.tar.gz --redact enabled, service-account redactor present. Presign host (masked): https://presign.rw-inference.internal/upload?sig=REDACTED

dan: Request IDs shown by presign: req_0ab12cd345, req_0ab12cd346 

support-bot: Created debug bundle task DB-2035001234 for T-9421 :white_check_mark:

chris: Quick checklist for repro: (1) was collector invoked with --redact or REDACTOR_MODE set? (2) is signed-manifest actually generated and checksum matches bundle? (3) presign token TTL valid at upload time?

priya: Note: on some private installs the redactor is disabled if REDACTOR_MODE environment var isn't set. If redaction is skipped the manifest still references redacted filenames -> checksum mismatch on ingest.

maria: dan — please run a local curl repro to the presign (mask token) and paste the -v output. Example we ask customers to run:

```
curl -v -F \"file=@debug-bundle.tar.gz\" \"https://presign.rw-inference.internal/upload?sig=REDACTED\" -H \"x-rw-collector: collector-203\"
```

If you get 403 include the full verbose output and the request_id.

acme-sre: Attaching what we ran (token masked):

```
$ curl -v -F \"file=@debug-bundle.tar.gz\" \"https://presign.rw-inference.internal/upload?sig=eyJhb...REDACTED\" -H \"x-rw-collector: collector-203\"
*   Trying 10.10.0.5:443...
* Connected to presign.rw-inference.internal (10.10.0.5) port 443 (#0)
> POST /upload?sig=eyJhb...REDACTED HTTP/1.1
> Host: presign.rw-inference.internal
> User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
> Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=------------------------d74496d66958873e
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 145
<
{"error":"upload_not_allowed","request_id":"req_0ab12cd345","detail":"uploader ip not in allowed list"}
* Connection #0 to host presign.rw-inference.internal left intact
```

acme-sre: Server logs also show uploader ip not in allowed list even though our edge proxy CIDRs are in the install manifest.

maria: OK two separate problems likely: (A) presign rejecting ip (network/access list mismatch) and (B) potential redaction/manifest checksum mismatch. For engineering we need exact repro bundle info:
- collector binary + output of `collector --version` and flags used (or systemd unit)
- contents of `/var/lib/redwood/collector/manifest.json` (sanitize hostnames/ids)
- sha256 of debug-bundle.tar.gz locally (`sha256sum debug-bundle.tar.gz`)
- exact `curl -v` output (you included request_id)
- slice of collector logs around bundle creation (/var/log/redwood/collector.log lines with \"bundle\" or \"manifest\")

chris: Also run `jq .manifest_checksum /var/lib/redwood/collector/manifest.json` and paste result so we can compare to sha256sum output.

dan: One more note: the SFTP presign proxy occasionally returns 403 with `{"error":"signature_invalid"}` when the presign URL is malformed (newline encoding/CRLF) — double-check the client doesn't add extra CRLF to the URL.

priya: If redaction was skipped, the safe repro is: set env `REDACTOR_MODE=local` (or for forced re-redact `REDACTOR_FORCE_REDACT=1`), then run: `collector bundle create --redact --out debug-bundle.tar.gz` and request a fresh presign from the control plane. Don't copy-paste typos into env var names.

maria: Dan — once you have logs and manifest.json please paste the 3-minute window around create (3m before -> 3m after) and the sha256 output. We'll triage and if presign is rejecting valid CIDRs we'll open a backend presign-server incident.

dan: I'll coordinate with ACME SRE and upload logs + sha256 here. Thanks all :pray:

support-bot: Ticket T-9421 updated: awaiting logs from customer. Reminder set for 24h.
